explanation.headline: Voriconazole is not on FDA's shortage list; supply traces to Aurobindo Pharma Limited plant with past OAI and recent VAI inspections

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list shows voriconazole is not listed as of 2026-10-21.
The product label identifies the manufacturing plant as Aurobindo Pharma Limited (FEI 3007373532) in India.
FDA inspection records for that plant show an OAI classification after an inspection ending 2019-09-27 and a VAI classification after an inspection ending 2022-05-10.
No FDA shortage posting exists to link those inspections to a current shortage.
Corvale East has 6.3 days of 50 mg tablets on hand; Corvale Lakeside has 26.3 days and can spare 36 tablets while retaining 14 days.
The recommended action is to transfer 36 tablets from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East, raising East to 9 days on hand.

rejected.text: All three Corvale sites stock the same NDC 65862089103 labeled by Aurobindo Pharma Limited.
rejected.reason: "three" is a number in words; numbers must be digits from the evidence

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
